manifest.method: isolated instrumented Rust GlobalAlloc delegates unchanged to System; [live requested bytes, cumulative peak, allocation/reallocation calls]; no malloc headers, size-class slack, C APIs, RSS or native MCP timing attribution
manifest.repetition: 100 rounds of four fixed Unicode/ASCII/whitespace strings; direct output equals frozen direct outputs, singleton pointer remains identical
manifest.scope: No production or dependency source changes; this is constructor-phase live Rust allocation attribution, not performance adoption or long-lived leak proof

manifest.source_dirty_only: Cargo.lock registry source/checksum removal for local dependency override
manifest.build_kind: offline locked ordinary release-profile CLI, cfg(test)=false, local config patch override; experimental, not published or adopted

criteria.scope: paired component hypothesis only; global host-admission recommendation and product/latency/backpressure gates remain independent; no production adoption from microcounters
criteria.native_cpu_gate_scope: per workload, request-weighted aggregate across all identical topology/process-count cells and paired arms; require baseline >=200 CPU-ms (20 ticks); finer cells remain descriptive
criteria.native_cold_cpu_gate_scope: total cold startup CPU divided by total observed repositories, over identical paired topology/count arms
criteria.native_latency_gate_scope: each workload/topology/process-count cell: median of its four observed p95 values per binary
criteria.native_memory_gate_scope: shared-cache eight-process cohort: median of its four aggregate PSS/private snapshots per binary

observation_limits: RSS, HWM, threads, file descriptors, lock ownership, and watcher ownership require Linux /proc.
Established read connections are inferred as main-database file descriptors minus the one writer connection.
SQLite does not expose cross-process statement counts; successful response-accounting updates and generation publications are reported as observed writes.
Latency is host-local wall time from one orchestrator and is comparable only on the same host and release build.
Startup readiness and concurrent-query responses are observed by one orchestrator in process order, so later processes can include bounded client-side receipt delay.
Watcher backend is confirmed with Linux inotify descriptors; admission counters are parsed from the product's structured tracing fields.

Response parity removes JSON-RPC request ids, generated receipt_id/repository_id values and matching native v1 receipt references, instantaneous freshness, and their derived path_and_metadata_tokens/total_response_tokens accounting (the independent topology uses distinct canonical roots and concurrent freshness is a liveness observation), then compares the remaining observable fields across processes, workloads, topologies, and ABBA repetitions. Files continuation comparison additionally requires the full in-session validation described below. Conflicting payload identities and mismatched receipt references remain significant.

Files cursors are compared semantically only after complete ordered fixture traversal through their owning session and deterministic continuation replay. The verified first-page cursor becomes a complete-page fingerprint; unknown warm cursors remain significant. Validation requests are outside timed warm rounds but included in query-accounting/WAL denominators.

The explicit max_index_workers value applies to every indexing attempt in this profiler. A two-worker run is a cold-start contention probe, not evidence that warm reconciliation should use two workers.

import hashlib,json,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
base=Path("/work/fixes/604/tokenizer-shared-bytes-prototype")
manifest=json.loads((base/"native-candidate-manifest.json").read_text())
profiler=Path("/work/fixes/636/candidate-profiler-release-b23728ca8")
original=Path("/work/fixes/604/candidate-leantoken-release-39efa0cbf")
candidate=Path(manifest["candidate_cli_path"])
assert hashlib.sha256(profiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="8af743da46dd8843f1d6269046d63c4bf5c46d450df1656c75de0e752e290bbf"
assert hashlib.sha256(original.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="e2d1bfb8b8fd64e6567c283d05f83d52559a4a25fc5115c54b223f236b086911"
assert hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==manifest["candidate_cli_sha256"]
criteria=json.loads((base/"native-predeclared-criteria.json").read_text())
assert criteria["native_matrix_order"]==["original","candidate","candidate","original"]
rows=[]
for arm,name in enumerate(criteria["native_matrix_order"]):
 binary=original if name=="original" else candidate
 output=base/f"native-paired-arm-{arm}-{name}.json"
 log=base/f"native-paired-arm-{arm}-{name}.log"
 assert not output.exists() and not log.exists()
 active=[]
 for p in Path("/proc").glob("[0-9]*"):
  try:
   command=(p/"cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0")[0].decode(errors="replace")
   if (p/"comm").read_text().strip() in ["cargo","rustc"] or command in [str(original),str(candidate),str(profiler)]:active.append((p.name,command))
  except OSError:pass
 assert not active,active
 args=[str(profiler),"--binary",str(binary),"--max-index-workers","1","--process-counts","1,4,8","--files","200","--functions-per-file","40","--warm-iterations","25","--idle-seconds","9","--polling-directories","50001","--polling-observation-seconds","31","--timeout-seconds","30","--output",str(output)]
 start=time.time()
 print(json.dumps({"event":"arm_start","arm":arm,"binary":name,"at_unix_seconds":start}),flush=True)
 with log.open("w") as stream:result=subprocess.run(args,stdout=stream,stderr=stream)
 assert result.returncode==0,(arm,result.returncode,str(log))
 report=json.loads(output.read_text())
 assert report["schema_version"]==5 and report["fixture_files"]==200 and report["warm_iterations_per_process"]==25
 assert len(report["runs"])==12
 assert sum(r["parity_checked"] for r in report["runs"])==5404
 assert sum(r["parity_mismatches"] for r in report["runs"])==0
 assert sum(r["files_pagination_validation_requests"] for r in report["runs"])==1040
 assert sum(len(r["processes"]) for r in report["runs"])==52
 assert sum(r["takeover"] is not None for r in report["runs"])==4
 for r in report["runs"]:
  assert r["leader_lock_owners"]==r["repository_count"]==r["watcher_processes"]
  assert r["expected_response_accounting_updates"]==r["process_count"]*125
  for metric in ["rollup_rss_kib","pss_kib","private_kib"]:
   values=[p["resources"][metric] for p in r["processes"]]
   assert all(v is not None for v in values) and sum(values)==r["aggregate_"+metric]
  if r["takeover"] is not None:
   t=r["takeover"]
   assert t["leadership_acquisition_ms"]<=report["thresholds"]["max_leadership_acquisition_ms"]
   assert t["generation_ready_after_acquisition_ms"]<=report["thresholds"]["max_generation_ready_after_acquisition_ms"]
   assert t["watcher_processes_after_takeover"]==1
 assert report["periodic_poll"]["reconciliations_at_ready"]==0 and report["periodic_poll"]["reconciliations_during_observation"]>=1
 row={"arm":arm,"binary":name,"elapsed_seconds":time.time()-start,"report_path":str(output),"report_sha256":hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"parity_checks":5404,"parity_mismatches":0,"page_validation_requests":1040,"checked_normal_eof_paths":49,"intentional_leader_kills":4,"decision":report["decision"]}
 rows.append(row);(base/"native-paired-completion.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+"\n")
 print(json.dumps({"event":"arm_complete",**row}),flush=True)
